name: bug_author_media_unconditional
description: AUTHOR @media CONDITIONALITY (task #23, found 2026-08-10 while fixing the shrink-to-mobile bug): restyle()'s rule-matching pushed every Static declaration without ever reading rule.conditions, so an author-stylesheet '@media (max-width: 720px)' block applied at EVERY viewport — at 900px wide the mobile width was already active. (The INLINE conditional channel — NodeData style rules with ViewportWidth conditions, the ribbon's mechanism — evaluated correctly all along; only stylesheet @-rule conditions were dropped.) This scenario pins both halves at a 900px window and then across the breakpoint: the box is 100px wide at 900 (the @media rule must NOT apply), and after shrinking to 600 — which crosses the harvested 720 threshold and therefore regenerates + re-styles — the box is 200px wide (the rule MUST apply). The shrink half also exercises the harvested-breakpoints resize decision end-to-end through the author-css channel.
